title: EventEnvelope
description: Common wrapper present on every Kafka event.

eventId.description: Unique ID for this event instance — used for idempotency checks.

eventType.description: Matches the Kafka topic name, e.g. order-created.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was produced.

version.description: Schema version — increment when making breaking payload changes.

payload.description: Event-specific data — defined by each event schema.
